name: @proworks-hub/expenseiq
description: ExpenseIQ — expense policy as versioned data over a closed rule vocabulary: total evaluation where a missing input is undeterminable and undeterminable outranks everything, per-diem entitlement with the partial-day factor on M&IE only, mileage with mid-year rate splits and cumulative tiers that never assume zero, ordinal card matching that never scores, and personal-charge candidates that carry reply paths instead of accusations.
author: Steven Kreutzer
